description: The single source of truth for the pipeline node `type:` values each layer admits. Read by the Worker compiler test (services/elitea-worker-rust src/agents/graph/node_admission_parity_tests.rs), the Main save-time admission test (services/elitea-main internal/domain/pipelinelimits) and the Web editor test (apps/elitea-web runtimeContract.constants.test.ts). A node type is added here and in every layer in the same change; there are no feature flags for admission.

pending_wave_2a.comment: KNOWN DRIFT, recorded so that any new drift fails. `map` is admitted (2026-10-13): the Worker composes it in the pipeline a conversation starts, with an inline `state_modifier` worker; every other Map form is refused when the graph is bound, with a named reason. `parallel` is not composed yet: the Worker compiler parses it but refuses it when the graph is bound (its branches are Agent nodes, which need the scoped Agent continuation and per-interrupt fan-out HITL, neither of which is accepted), Main's save check admits it, and the Web editor lists it (the Add-node menu hides it behind FIXED_PARALLEL_AUTHORING_ENABLED). This object MUST become empty (and move `parallel` into `admitted`) when Parallel is composed. Each layer's test asserts its admitted set equals `admitted` plus exactly its own entry below.
